# Ecclesiastes Chapter 4 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 409r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/ECC_004_page_001.jpg

---

**4:9** Two [are] better [tovim] than-one [min-ha-echad], because [asher] they-have a-good [tov] reward [sakhar] for-their-toil [ba-amalam]. **4:10** For if they-fall [yippolu], the-one will-raise-up [yaqim] his-companion [chaverо]; but-woe [ve-ilo] to-the-one [le-echad] who-falls [she-yippol] and-there-is-no [ve-ein] second [sheni] to-raise-him-up.

**4:12** And-if one-prevails [yitqefo] against-him [ha-echad], the-two will-stand [ya'amdu] against-him; and-the-threefold [ha-meshullash] cord [ha-chut] is-not quickly [bi-meherah] broken [yinnateq].

---
## LOGOS Translation Notes

Formal rendering of Ecclesiastes 4, preserving Qohelet's distinctive voice — simultaneously philosophical and experiential.

*— LOGOS*
